skill_model.list_description: Read the existing skill catalog or model-scoped target candidates and learned history. canMaster reports native mastery conditions, not complete UI eligibility.
skill_model.id: Exact live duplicant InstanceID. A supplied unresolved ID never falls back to another target.
skill_model.name: Exact duplicant name. Duplicate names require an explicit ID; an accompanying ID must identify the same duplicant.
skill_model.query: Filter skill ID, name, group or description after target model filtering.
skill_model.limit: Maximum returned rows: default 100, maximum 300. Model filtering precedes this limit.
skill_model.include_ui: List only: include existing exact-target SkillsScreen/widget state. Default false; never opens, selects or refreshes UI.
skill_model.learn_description: Learn through the normal exact-target Skills UI. dryRun does not open UI, click or grant. Explicit force=true retains the external GrantSkill path.
skill_model.skill_id: Exact native skill ID for learning or a single-skill preview.
skill_model.force: Skill learn only: explicitly request legacy external GrantSkill instead of normal UI. Default false; never a fallback, and dryRun still performs no grant.
skill_model.dry_run: Skill open/learn only: return a preview without opening UI, clicking, mastering or granting skills.
skill_model.confirm: Required true for actual skill UI opening or learning; dryRun is nonmutating.
skill_model.preview_guidance: Preview only. Existing widget visibility and native mastery conditions do not guarantee a future learning action.
skill_model.action_unavailable: The requested skill data or native UI action is unavailable. Inspect reasonCode; no lower-level fallback is performed.
skill_model.control_description: Skill list, exact-target UI open, or learn. Normal learning delegates to an active native widget; explicit force grants remain separate.
skill_model.action: list: read candidates; open: explicitly open the target Skills UI; learn: preview or execute one skill.
skill_model.invalid_action: Skill action must be list, open or learn.
skill_model.table_base_header: | Group | Tier | ID | Name | Morale | Requires | Required model |
skill_model.table_target_header: Mastered | Native conditions | Model match | Scope |
